info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Warehouse Inventory Audits-v3-spec
info.description: The Warehouse Inventory Audit Retrieval API provides access to detailed records of inventory audits conducted within warehouses. This endpoint allows users to retrieve historical audit data, enabling businesses to maintain transparency and track inventory variances. Typical consumers include supply chain managers and inventory controllers who require insights for inventory reconciliation and decision-making. By efficiently accessing audit histories, organizations can optimize inventory management processes and enhance their operational effectiveness.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed audit information related to the inventory. It provides insights into inventory changes, adjustments, and relevant timestamps.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the audit information for the inventory. The client should provide a valid JSON object that meets the schema requirements defined in the specification.

ListWarehouseInventoryAuditsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the Inventory Audit API.

ListWarehouseInventoryAuditsResponse_200.title: Inventory Audit Response

status.description: Indicates whether the audit operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the audit.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the audit operation.

state.description: The current state of the audit process.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the audit, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the audit operation.

audit.description: Contains details about the audit process, including who created it and when.

ListWarehouseInventoryAuditsResponse_200.description: The response schema for a successful inventory audit operation, returning details about the audit process.

AuditDetails.title: Audit Details

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the audit.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the audit was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the audit was created automatically by a system.

AuditDetails.description: Detailed information about the audit including created by, creation time, and whether it was automated.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time it took to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
